title: AI Pre-Call Brief Benchmark: Clay vs two data providers
description: One task from a seven-task pre-registered agent study, published on its own: an AI agent writes 50 pre-call research briefs on Clay and on two anonymized data providers through each platform's own tools, and a blind AI reviewer with web search scores a sample for accuracy, specificity, usefulness and fabricated facts. Holds the method, the task as a Harbor task, the scoring code and the results; the accounts file and per-brief ratings are private. Not independently reviewed; one run per platform.
